title: MoonWitness versioned story episode
description: A versioned slice of one exact story version. An episode names a contiguous page range and binds the referenced story version by ID, version number, and canonical digest, so it can never reorder, re-point, or restate story text. The storage layer must verify the referenced story version and keep first_page_order at or below last_page_order inside that version's page count; JSON Schema cannot read the referenced version. Visibility is fixed to INTERNAL; this contract has no publication, rendering, or auto-publish semantics.
